text.p: These are some of the leading stories in the Jordanian press on Monday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Prime Minister Kabariti says 400 million dinar ($565 million) social spending package will get priority in next year's budget.
- King to make wide-ranging speech today at opening of conference on Arab political parties.
- Kabariti says he's committed to presenting new election law during present session of parliament.
- End-of-year transactions in bank shares increase volume on Amman stock exchange.
- Tunisian Prime Minister Karoui, arriving in Amman, affirms Tunis' keenness to activate cooperation between the two countries.
- Cabinet reviews Information Minister Muasher's visit to Israel. Muasher says Israel's settlement policy threatens Jordan and revives concept that Jordan is an alternative homeland for Palestinians.
- 400 million dinars next year to improve standard of living for Jordan's poor.
- Nearly all of domestic violence in Amman is attacks against wives.
- Convicted murderer hanged at dawn on Sunday.
